source.commit_scope: Application implementation is pinned by application_code_commit. Windows-release-validation.json identifies the exact release tag/build commit and final checks.

ki_library.scope: Bundled 127 scientific KIs and 2 observation data KIs retain the prior release snapshot. Updated desktop/shared-flow code is pinned by source.application_code_commit. Downloaded Library updates and local KDT-approved repairs are separate; the DSSAT acceptance used those separate revisions.

changes.summary: Bind setup, runtime paths and required data to current KI/recipe/helper identities; refresh current project readiness after changes.
Enforce KDT maintenance, reuse valid evidence and expose compatible signed repairs during fresh Auto KI inspection without granting runtime readiness.
Check ready inputs, actual typed arguments and output contracts before review/approval; continue after project preflight and require current signed evidence.
Separate completed execution from scientific validation; prevent stale approval popups crossing chats and failed attempts satisfying current work.
Bundle runtime_data source identity and correctly compose Codex fresh/resumed sandbox arguments.
Carry verified native executable aliases into signed input evidence, pin target bytes and reject retargeted aliases without relaxing ordinary input path checks.
Clean up observed child processes after wrapper exit and preserve the actual virtual-environment wrapper during bounded graceful Stop so it can record the outcome.

platform_notes.windows: Windows x64 only. Python is included; AI providers and scientific models are configured or installed separately. Browser frontend and tray exit are retained.
platform_notes.macos: This release does not replace the macOS application assets.
platform_notes.linux: This release does not replace the Linux application assets.

validation.release_checks: Final source, packaged-runtime, installer lifecycle and asset hashes are recorded in Windows-release-validation.json and attached JUnit reports.

prior_gui_acceptance.scope: Existing installed runtime and separately KDT-approved local repair; no bundled-KI, new-site, calibration, or all-model claim.

limits: DS plan construction required reviewer corrections.
Live Claude inspection was blocked by expired OAuth.
Live Codex inspection was blocked by installed CLI/model/reasoning compatibility; fresh/resume command composition passed independent tests.
Native macOS/Linux application testing is outside this Windows release.

agent_update_protocol: Read release-manifest.json before changing an installation.
Compare product version, source.code_commit and source.release_tag for application changes.
Compare ki_library.source_commit and windows_overlay_commit for bundled KI changes.
Preserve user settings, API keys, proxy choices, projects, data and recorded model installation paths.
Verify the downloaded Windows asset against SHA256SUMS-Windows.txt.
Report the applied change IDs and any migration or retry action to the user.

guides.scope: Unchanged reviewed 0.6.55 PDF/HTML edition, including illustrated three-page quickstarts in English and Chinese, bundled with Windows 0.6.60.
